cn_steps: 启用 `ML Deformer Neural Morph Model`（运行时 `NeuralMorphModel`，编辑器 `NeuralMorphModelEditor`）。
它是 ML Deformer 框架的“神经变形模型”，用神经网络学习网格变形。
在 ML Deformer 资产里选 Neural Morph Model，训练后驱动骨骼网格变形。
Game 模块依赖 `NeuralMorphModel`；`NeuralMorphModelEditor` 只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `ML Deformer Neural Morph Model` (runtime `NeuralMorphModel`, editor `NeuralMorphModelEditor`).
It is the Neural Morph Model for the ML Deformer framework, using a neural network to learn mesh deformation.
Select Neural Morph Model in an ML Deformer asset; after training, drive skeletal mesh deformation.
Game modules depend on `NeuralMorphModel`; `NeuralMorphModelEditor` is Editor-target only.
note_cn: ML Deformer 的神经变形模型（可插拔模型之一）。
note_en: A Neural Morph Model for ML Deformer (one of the pluggable models).

cn_steps: 启用 `ML Deformer Vertex Delta Model`（运行时 `VertexDeltaModel`，编辑器 `VertexDeltaModelEditor`）。
它是 ML Deformer 框架的“顶点增量模型”，学习逐顶点偏移来表现变形细节。
在 ML Deformer 资产里选 Vertex Delta Model，训练后应用到角色。
Game 模块依赖 `VertexDeltaModel`；`VertexDeltaModelEditor` 只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `ML Deformer Vertex Delta Model` (runtime `VertexDeltaModel`, editor `VertexDeltaModelEditor`).
It is the Vertex Delta Model for the ML Deformer framework, learning per-vertex offsets for deformation detail.
Select Vertex Delta Model in an ML Deformer asset, train it, and apply to the character.
Game modules depend on `VertexDeltaModel`; `VertexDeltaModelEditor` is Editor-target only.
note_cn: ML Deformer 的顶点增量模型（逐顶点偏移）。
note_en: The ML Deformer Vertex Delta Model (per-vertex offsets).

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `MLflow` 插件（无独立模块列表）。
它提供可选的 mlflow Python 包及其依赖，便于在训练流程里追踪实验。
配合 ML 相关插件（如 Learning Agents / Python 训练）记录指标与模型。
这是可选 Python 依赖包，不是运行时功能；Experimental。
en_steps: Enable the Experimental `MLflow` plugin (no standalone module list).
It provides the optional mlflow Python package and dependencies to track experiments in training flows.
Use it with ML-related plugins (e.g. Learning Agents / Python training) to log metrics and models.
It is an optional Python dependency pack, not a runtime feature; Experimental.
note_cn: 可选的 mlflow Python 包/依赖，用于训练实验追踪。
note_en: An optional mlflow Python package/deps for experiment tracking.

cn_steps: 启用 `Mobile Location Services - Android Implementation`（模块 `LocationServicesAndroidImpl`，编辑器 `LocationServicesAndroidEditor`）。
它是移动定位服务蓝图接口在 Android 上的实现。
在 Android 设备上通过蓝图读取经纬度定位数据。
需同时启用通用蓝图库 `Mobile Location Services Blueprints Library`；打包到 Android 生效。
en_steps: Enable `Mobile Location Services - Android Implementation` (module `LocationServicesAndroidImpl`, editor `LocationServicesAndroidEditor`).
It is the Android implementation of the mobile location-services Blueprint interface.
Read lat/long location data via Blueprint on Android devices.
Also enable the common `Mobile Location Services Blueprints Library`; takes effect when packaged to Android.
note_cn: 移动定位服务蓝图接口的 Android 实现。
note_en: The Android implementation of the mobile location-services Blueprint interface.

cn_steps: 启用 `Mobile Location Services - IOS Implementation`（模块 `LocationServicesIOSImpl`，编辑器 `LocationServicesIOSEditor`）。
它是移动定位服务蓝图接口在 iOS 上的实现。
在 iOS 设备上通过蓝图读取经纬度定位数据（申请定位权限）。
需同时启用通用蓝图库 `Mobile Location Services Blueprints Library`；打包到 iOS 生效。
en_steps: Enable `Mobile Location Services - IOS Implementation` (module `LocationServicesIOSImpl`, editor `LocationServicesIOSEditor`).
It is the iOS implementation of the mobile location-services Blueprint interface.
Read lat/long location data via Blueprint on iOS devices (request location permission).
Also enable the common `Mobile Location Services Blueprints Library`; takes effect when packaged to iOS.
note_cn: 移动定位服务蓝图接口的 iOS 实现。
note_en: The iOS implementation of the mobile location-services Blueprint interface.

cn_steps: 启用 `Mobile Location Services Blueprints Library`（模块 `LocationServicesBPLibrary`），运行时插件。
它提供从移动设备获取位置数据的通用蓝图接口。
配合平台实现（Android/iOS）一起用，在蓝图里调用定位节点。
运行时模块可进游戏包；需对应平台实现插件。
en_steps: Enable `Mobile Location Services Blueprints Library` (module `LocationServicesBPLibrary`), a runtime plugin.
It provides the common Blueprint interface for reading location data from mobile devices.
Use it with the platform implementations (Android/iOS) and call the location nodes in Blueprint.
Runtime modules can ship; requires the matching platform-implementation plugin.
note_cn: 移动定位的通用蓝图接口（配合平台实现）。
note_en: The common Blueprint interface for mobile location (paired with platform impls).

cn_steps: 启用 `Mobile Patching Utilities`（模块 `MobilePatchingUtils`），运行时插件。
它通过蓝图公开在移动平台下载与修补内容的能力。
在蓝图中调用其 API 下载/安装补丁内容包，处理进度。
运行时模块可进游戏包；平台/服务器方案由项目提供。
en_steps: Enable `Mobile Patching Utilities` (module `MobilePatchingUtils`), a runtime plugin.
It exposes Blueprint functionality for downloading and patching content on mobile platforms.
Call its API from Blueprint to download/install patch content packs and handle progress.
Runtime modules can ship; platform/server solutions are provided by your project.
note_cn: 移动平台蓝图的下载/修补内容工具。
note_en: Blueprint download/patch content utilities for mobile.

cn_steps: 启用编辑器插件 `Modeling Tools Editor Mode`（模块 `ModelingToolsEditorMode`）并重启。
它提供建模工具模式：一套在编辑器里创建/编辑网格的交互式工具。
在模式工具栏进入建模模式，对网格做建模、布尔、雕刻等操作。
这是编辑器工具，只进 Editor Target，不进 Shipping。
en_steps: Enable the editor plugin `Modeling Tools Editor Mode` (module `ModelingToolsEditorMode`) and restart.
It provides Modeling Tools Mode: a suite of interactive tools to create/edit meshes in the editor.
Enter Modeling Mode from the mode toolbar and model, boolean, sculpt meshes, etc.
It is an editor tool for Editor targets only; it does not ship.
note_cn: 编辑器中的建模工具模式（Interactive Tools）。
note_en: The in-editor Modeling Tools Mode (Interactive Tools).

cn_steps: 启用 `Modular Gameplay`（模块 `ModularGameplay`）。
它提供支持游戏框架模块化使用的基类与子系统（如 ModularGameplayActorComponent、GameFrameworkComponentManager）。
用它在 Game Feature 插件里动态给 Actor 添加/移除组件，实现模块化玩法。
Game 模块依赖 `ModularGameplay`；是 Game Features 的常用底层。
en_steps: Enable `Modular Gameplay` (module `ModularGameplay`).
It provides base classes and subsystems for modular use of the gameplay framework (e.g. ModularGameplayActorComponent, GameFrameworkComponentManager).
Use it to dynamically add/remove components on actors inside Game Feature plugins for modular gameplay.
Game modules depend on `ModularGameplay`; it is a common base for Game Features.
note_cn: Game Features 模块化玩法的基类/子系统。
note_en: Base classes/subsystems for modular gameplay (Game Features).

cn_steps: 启用 `Modular Test Framework Self-Tests`（模块 `ModularTestFrameworkTests`）。
它对模块化测试框架本身做冒烟测试，验证框架可用性。
在 CI/自动化里跑这些用例，确保 MTF 正常。
这是测试配套插件，不要打进发行版本。
en_steps: Enable `Modular Test Framework Self-Tests` (module `ModularTestFrameworkTests`).
It smoke-tests the Modular Test Framework itself to verify framework health.
Run these cases in CI/automation to ensure MTF works.
It is a test companion; do not ship it in release builds.
note_cn: 模块化测试框架自身的冒烟测试。
note_en: Smoke tests for the Modular Test Framework itself.

cn_steps: 启用 `Modular Test Framework`（模块 `ModularTestFramework`、`ModularTestRunner`）。
它是引擎级框架，用于编写和运行范围化的插件测试（scoped plugin tests）。
按框架约定编写测试，用 Runner 在编辑器/自动化里运行。
属测试框架；配套截图/GFP/UI 测试等可选插件按需加。
en_steps: Enable `Modular Test Framework` (modules `ModularTestFramework`, `ModularTestRunner`).
It is an engine-level framework for authoring and running scoped plugin tests.
Write tests per the framework's conventions and run them via the Runner in editor/automation.
It is a test framework; optional screenshot/GFP/UI test companions are added as needed.
note_cn: 编写/运行范围化插件测试的引擎级框架。
note_en: An engine-level framework for authoring/running scoped plugin tests.

cn_steps: 启用 `Modular Test GFP Self-Tests`（模块 `ModularTestGFPTests`）。
它对 `Modular Test GFP` 插件做冒烟测试。
在 CI/自动化里跑这些用例，验证 GFP 测试能力。
这是测试配套插件，不要打进发行版本。
en_steps: Enable `Modular Test GFP Self-Tests` (module `ModularTestGFPTests`).
It smoke-tests the `Modular Test GFP` plugin.
Run these cases in CI/automation to validate GFP test capability.
It is a test companion; do not ship it in release builds.
note_cn: Modular Test GFP 的冒烟测试。
note_en: Smoke tests for Modular Test GFP.

cn_steps: 启用 `Modular Test GFP`（模块 `ModularTestGFP`）。
它是模块化测试框架的可选 GFP（Game Feature Plugin）测试套件与实用程序。
需要激活 Game Feature Plugin 的测试应依赖它。
属测试可选插件；配合 `Modular Test Framework`。
en_steps: Enable `Modular Test GFP` (module `ModularTestGFP`).
It is the optional GFP (Game Feature Plugin) test suite and utilities for the Modular Test Framework.
Tests that need to activate Game Feature Plugins should depend on it.
It is an optional test plugin; used with `Modular Test Framework`.
note_cn: 模块化测试框架的可选 GFP 测试套件（需激活 Game Feature）。
note_en: Optional GFP test suite for the Modular Test Framework (activates Game Features).

cn_steps: 启用 `Modular Test Resolver`（模块 `ModularTestResolver`）。
它是 `ModularTestFramework` 的插件解析接口。
供框架解析定位测试所需的插件；一般作为 MTF 的配套使用。
属测试支撑模块。
en_steps: Enable `Modular Test Resolver` (module `ModularTestResolver`).
It is the plugin resolution interface for the `ModularTestFramework`.
It lets the framework resolve/locate the plugins a test needs; used as an MTF companion.
It is a test-support module.
note_en: The plugin resolution interface for ModularTestFramework.

cn_steps: 启用编辑器插件 `Modular Test Runner Editor`（模块 `ModularTestRunnerUI`、`ModularTestToolset`、`ModularTestTemplate`）并重启。
它提供模块化测试框架的编辑器实用程序与 Runner UI/Toolset/模板。
在编辑器里用 Runner UI 选择/运行 MTF 测试。
这是编辑器工具，只进 Editor Target，不进 Shipping。
en_steps: Enable the editor plugin `Modular Test Runner Editor` (modules `ModularTestRunnerUI`, `ModularTestToolset`, `ModularTestTemplate`) and restart.
It provides editor utilities plus Runner UI/Toolset/templates for the Modular Test Framework.
Use the Runner UI in the editor to select/run MTF tests.
It is an editor tool for Editor targets only; it does not ship.
note_cn: 模块化测试框架的编辑器 UI/工具/模板。
note_en: Editor UI/toolset/templates for the Modular Test Framework.
